summary: A reader can ask the library to review an unavailable page from the terminal without identifying themselves to the desk.
realLife: Tacoma allowed patrons to send an access review request without supplying identifying information or a return email address.
inGame: needs: local review procedure and contact requirements.

turns.what: Staff receive the page address without a personal explanation at the counter.

turns.pulledBy: The reader wants a direct response.
turns.what: Staff explain what contact information would be needed.
turns.writesBack: The reader decides whether to supply it.
